notes: Do not exceed max_steer to avoid servo strain. Radii measured for max steer angle. target_distance_cm = closest approach distance (cm) for obstacle/approach logic. obstacle_too_close_cm = proximity stop distance, applied by DecisionEngine as a floor under CAT_FOLLOW_BRAKE_REVERSE_TRIGGER_CM (the larger value wins); obstacle_detected_cm = veto ramp start (must be greater).
